remarks: This spacious "Dalton model" at Foxboro is in move-in-perfect condition & is sure to impress! Upon entering you will enjoy a sophisticated main floor w/LR, DR, Kitchen & Den or possible 3rd bedroom. The all-new white kitchen is super bright & boasts quartzite counters, stainless steel appliances & space for seating or additional storage/work area. The Living & Dining rooms are adjacent but separated by a two sided fireplace w/gas log insert. Off the LR is a private deck for entertaining w/enough space to accommodate couch seating, a table w/chairs & BBQ. Views outward are of nature & greenery in a private setting. Lastly on the main level is a powder room & large den that could serve perfectly as a 3rd bedroom if needed. As you step upstairs you will enjoy a sun-drenched stairwell w/oversized windows and a beautiful hanging chandelier. The primary bedroom suite is spacious, offers a taller ceiling, walk in closet & massive en-suite bathroom. The second bedroom is also well proportioned, has great closet storage & enjoys its own en-suite bathroom. The lower level is comprised of 800+ square feet, offers storage, laundry & a partially finished space ideal for a recreation room, home office or gym. The garage is attached for easy access & provides even more storage. Foxboro Court is a desirable & well maintained complex in a convenient Norwalk location off rt 7 w/easy access to all major roads. Do not miss the link for video tour. Come visit this super townhome!
